hr.leave.v1.ApproveLeaveBody.description: ApproveLeaveBody carries approval decision fields bound from the HTTP payload.

approved.description: True to approve, false to reject.

rejection_reason.description: Reason for rejection; absent if approving.

request_id.description: request_id is the leave request being reviewed.

success.description: Whether the approval action was processed.

request_id.description:
request_id is the leave request being withdrawn. Only the request's own
subject may cancel it, and only while it is still pending - the leave
approval permission grants no override here.

success.description: Whether the request was still pending and is now canceled.

notes.description: Additional context from the employee; absent if none provided.

total_days.description: Total number of working days requested.

accrual_rule.description: Accrual rule; absent if entitlement is fixed.

is_paid.description: Whether days taken under this type are paid.

max_carryover_days.description: Maximum unused days that may carry over to the next year.

min_notice_days.description: Minimum calendar days of notice required.

requires_approval.description: Whether leave requests of this type require manager approval.

requires_documentation_after_days.description: Consecutive days after which documentation is required; absent if never.

hr.leave.v1.LeaveBalancePayload.description: LeaveBalancePayload tracks an employee's remaining entitlement for a leave type and year.

created_at.description: Unix timestamp when this record was created.

entitled_days.description: Total entitled days for the year (including carryover).

id.description: Unique identifier for the balance record.

owner_id.description: Tenant owner this balance belongs to.

pending_days.description: Days reserved by pending (not yet approved) requests.

updated_at.description: Unix timestamp when this record was last updated.

used_days.description: Days already consumed by approved requests.

year.description: Calendar year this balance applies to.

hr.leave.v1.LeaveRequestPayload.description: LeaveRequestPayload is a single employee's request for time off.

created_at.description: Unix timestamp when this record was created.

current_approval_level.description: Current step in a multi-level approval chain.

id.description: Unique identifier for the leave request.

notes.description: Additional context from the employee; absent if none provided.

owner_id.description: Tenant owner this request belongs to.

rejection_reason.description: Reason the request was rejected; absent unless status is rejected.

total_days.description: Total number of working days requested (may be fractional for half-days).

updated_at.description: Unix timestamp when this record was last updated.

hr.leave.v1.LeaveTypePayload.description: LeaveTypePayload defines a category of leave employees can request.

accrual_rule.description: Rule describing how entitlement accrues (e.g. "monthly", "yearly"); absent if entitlement is fixed.

created_at.description: Unix timestamp when this record was created.

id.description: Unique identifier for the leave type.

is_active.description: Whether this leave type is currently available for new requests.

is_paid.description: Whether days taken under this type are paid.

max_carryover_days.description: Maximum unused days that may carry over to the next year.

min_notice_days.description: Minimum calendar days of notice required before the leave starts.

owner_id.description: Tenant owner this leave type belongs to.

requires_approval.description: Whether leave requests of this type require manager approval.

requires_documentation_after_days.description: Number of consecutive days after which supporting documentation is required; absent if never required.

updated_at.description: Unix timestamp when this record was last updated.
